title: SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction
abstract: arXiv:2609.05511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to interna

translated_title: SCAFFOLD：通过递归参数化技能抽象实现自我改进的网页智能体
translated_abstract: 网页智能体需要在视觉信息丰富、跨越不同网站且不断变化的长时程界面中进行导航，然而以往的大多数智能体仍然孤立地学习每个任务，并丢弃其积累的程序性知识。近期的技能增强框架迈出了重要的第一步，但它们将技能库视为扁平或两层的提示端缓存，缺乏压缩冗余或递归组合技能的原则性机制。我们提出了SCAFFOLD，这是一个面向视觉网页智能体的自我改进框架，它： 在多实例抽象约束下从成功轨迹中归纳出参数化的、可执行的技能； 维护一个递归组合的层次结构，其中高层技能可以调用低层技能； 通过最小描述长度（MDL）准则和行为等价性检查来压缩技能库； 周期性地将技能增强的轨迹蒸馏回模型权重，以将这些知识内化……
tldr: SCAFFOLD是一个自我改进的视觉网页智能体框架，通过从成功轨迹中归纳参数化可执行技能、构建递归层次化技能库、以MDL准则压缩冗余，并将技能知识周期性蒸馏回模型权重，突破了以往技能库扁平化、无法递归组合的局限。
en_tdlr: SCAFFOLD is a self-improving framework for visual web agents that induces parametric executable skills from successful trajectories, maintains a recursively composed skill hierarchy, compresses library redundancy via MDL criteria and behavioral equivalence checks, and periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights.
